title: Advanced Paste: Foundry Local provider shows no models – empty Service URL with Foundry Local 0.10.x

judgment.rationale: The live report and independent follow-up confirm the same Foundry Local 0.10/0.11 endpoint-discovery failure already covered by an open fork-side design trace. Reuse that trace and do not create a competing plan. The fork trace is design coverage only, not a merged or verified code fix; the upstream issue remains open.
evidence: The issue describes Foundry Local 0.10.3 with an empty Service URL and invalid request URI errors when Advanced Paste lists catalog and cached models.
The 2026-10-16 commenter reproduces the same behavior with Foundry Local 0.11 and reports that the CLI can list cached models and serve its local endpoint.
The attached log contains the empty Service URL and model-listing failure sequence; no diagnostic-only details are copied into this artifact.
The current provider code constructs FoundryLocalManager, reads Endpoint/ServiceUri, calls manager model-list APIs, and treats a non-null client as available even if enumeration fails.
Fork issue #623 is open and contains an existing yellow endpoint-discovery design covering URI validation, provider availability, and model-listing verification; no matching fork PR was found.
Merged upstream PR #45362 addressed an older Foundry Local 0.8.119 fixed-port/runtime-refresh issue, not the reported 0.10.x/0.11 architecture change.
judgment.recommended_action: Carry forward the existing endpoint-discovery design in fork issue #623; do not duplicate design work. Any implementation must first verify the current SDK endpoint contract.

fix_assessment.rationale: An open fork-side design issue already covers the same root-cause hypothesis and verification path. It is not an implementation or upstream fix, and its remaining SDK endpoint-contract check is unresolved.

issue_context.summary: Advanced Paste does not list a Foundry Local model even though the CLI has loaded it and the daemon is running. The original report and a later 0.11 reproduction both show endpoint discovery returning empty and model enumeration failing.
known_information: The reporter lists PowerToys v0.101.2362.0, Foundry Local 0.10.3.0, model phi-4-mini, and Windows 11 24H2.
The issue body provides repro steps and logs showing an empty service URL and invalid URI errors for model listing.
A second commenter reports the same behavior with Foundry Local 0.11 and a working CLI/server endpoint.
Current FoundryClient.GetServiceUrl reads FoundryLocalManager.Endpoint; GetServiceUri reads ServiceUri; ListCatalogModels and ListCachedModels catch failures and return empty collections.
Current FoundryLocalModelProvider.IsAvailable reports available when the client object exists, without requiring a usable service URI or successful model enumeration.
The existing fork trace #623 is open, reports confidence 82/yellow, and proposes verifying the SDK contract before routing model enumeration through a validated endpoint.
Upstream PR #45362 is merged but concerns the earlier 0.8.119 service and changing-port scenario.
inferences: The observed empty model list is consistent with the provider's endpoint-based manager API failing against the newer Foundry Local runtime, but the exact SDK endpoint accessor has not been verified.
The existing issue #623 plan is relevant coverage; the trace itself does not prove that any implementation is active or shipped.
issue_context.analysis: The public evidence makes the failure reproducible and the current owner-code path explains how an empty endpoint can be masked as an available provider with no models. The existing fork design already captures the likely correction and its key uncertainty, so a new plan would duplicate work. Preserve the existing trace and distinguish it from the older upstream port-refresh fix.
initial_investigation: Read the entire live issue body and its sole user follow-up; inspected the attached plain-text log only for the relevant provider sequence and excluded local paths, machine-specific identifiers, and unrelated diagnostic contents.
Reviewed current upstream FoundryClient.cs and FoundryLocalModelProvider.cs at commit 1b33221dfa19f30d71409eb550807883fb27283a.
Read fork issue #623 and verified its state is OPEN; searched fork issues and PRs for #50368 and found no matching implementation PR.
Read upstream issue #45340 and merged PR #45362; their 0.8.119 fixed-port scope differs from this 0.10.x/0.11 report.
